bounded_contexts.name: managed-k8s-tenant-quota
bounded_contexts.description: Per-tenant quota and RBAC enforcement for managed Kubernetes clusters. Provides the QuotaDecision PORT (oya-managed-k8s-tenant-quota-api) that cluster-lifecycle calls before provisioning. ADR-0376.

bounded_contexts.name: managed-k8s-control-plane-host
bounded_contexts.description: Hosted-tier (Kamaji TenantControlPlane) + dedicated-tier (Talos spoke) tenant control-plane provisioning + management-cluster multi-tenancy hardening (ADR-0376). Provides the ControlPlaneProvisioning PORT (oya-managed-k8s-control-plane-host-api) that cluster-lifecycle + sla-observability consume. Control plane (provision/observe/teardown); never runs tenant workloads.

bounded_contexts.name: managed-k8s-cluster-lifecycle
bounded_contexts.description: Tenant-facing managed-Kubernetes cluster lifecycle admission. Consumes QuotaDecisionPort before ControlPlaneProvisioning; quota denial/not-found/failure fails closed and does not invoke provisioning.

bounded_contexts.name: managed-k8s-sla-observability
bounded_contexts.description: Tenant-scoped managed-Kubernetes SLA observability. Consumes the ControlPlaneProvisioning/status seam from oya-managed-k8s-control-plane-host-api, computes deterministic availability/provisioning-latency/error-budget summaries, and defers live Prometheus/Kubernetes integration behind the port.

slos.name: quota-decision-latency
slos.sli: QuotaDecision evaluate() on the cluster-lifecycle hot path must complete in under 1ms p99 (O(1) pure Rust, no I/O).

slos.name: managed-cluster-availability
slos.sli: healthy_status_samples / total_status_samples from managed-k8s SLA observation snapshots

slos.name: managed-cluster-provisioning-latency
slos.sli: provisioning_latency_millis from managed-k8s SLA observation snapshots

lts_pins.kube: 3.1 (pin lands in registry/lts-pins.yaml when kamaji-provider-live-integration wires the live reconcile per ADR-0376)
lts_pins.kamaji: version-agnostic at ADR-0376; concrete pin deferred to the live-integration follow-on ADR

adrs.title: Talos + Cluster API + Argo CD fleet substrate
Service mesh: Cilium L3/L4 + Istio Ambient L7

hyperscaler_inv_coverage.circuit_breaker: partial: the control-plane-host CAPI adapter fails closed (typed ProvisioningError) on management-cluster unreachability with no unbounded retry on the provision path; the tenant-quota concern has no circuit-breaker (pure in-memory hot path).
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: partial: per-tenant control-plane provisioning is admission-gated by Cedar (only platform/control-plane-operator may provision; tenants default-deny) before any management-cluster write; rate-limit on the quota-check endpoint is not yet implemented. Cluster-lifecycle create admission now fails closed on quota denial/not-found/failure before invoking control-plane provisioning.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: partial: control-plane provisioning-latency + status-availability SLIs declared in control-plane-host/slos/; tenant-quota emits no metrics yet. Cluster-lifecycle declares create-admission-latency on the quota/provisioning admission path. sla-observability adds deterministic DTO summaries for availability, provisioning latency, and current state from control-plane-host status snapshots; live metrics adapter remains deferred.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.error_budget_burn: partial: control-plane provisioning-latency + availability error budgets declared per control-plane-host/slos/*.openslo.yaml; tenant-quota declares quota-decision-latency but has no measured SLI/burn-rate rule yet. Cluster-lifecycle declares create-admission latency but no measured burn-rate rule yet. sla-observability adds deterministic error-budget remaining/burn summaries from healthy/total status samples; production Prometheus ingestion remains deferred behind the same port.

capacity_model.notes: ADR-0340 planning declaration only. tenant-quota evaluate() is O(1) pure Rust and its in-memory store is test-only; the control-plane-host in-memory adapter is the deterministic reference and the kube-rs CAPI live reconcile is honest-deferred. Production storage / live provisioning not yet wired. Cluster-lifecycle admission is a narrow composition over quota and control-plane-host ports; no new storage or external dependency introduced.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: Pure quota enforcement kernel + in-memory adapters; no database, no external I/O on the hot path. The control-plane-host app is a management-cluster-only control plane that never runs tenant workloads; the live CAPI reconcile is honest-deferred. ADR-0083 Tier-3.

threat_model.quota_bypass: mitigated: evaluate() checks all dimensions; deny-by-default when no quota record exists
threat_model.rbac_escalation: mitigated: Cedar default-deny; no principal can grant their own role; PlatformOperator scope required for cross-tenant writes
threat_model.cross_tenant_limit_read: mitigated: Cedar tenant_id condition on all read policies; TenantMismatch deny in evaluate()
threat_model.tenant_control_plane_escape: design-mitigated (live wiring honest-deferred): per-tenant NetworkPolicy / Cilium L3-L4 deny + Istio Ambient ztunnel so a tenant control plane can never reach the management cluster or a sibling tenant; the CAPI adapter returns Unimplemented until kamaji-provider-live-integration lands.
